title: Design System: MONO™ 방출선 셀렉티브 (Emission Line Rail)

display.purpose: The house wordmark, once, at the hero. Archivo width axis 72%, ™ as .32em superscript.

headline.purpose: Section headings and drop-countdown numerals. Archivo width axis 76–80%.

title.purpose: Look names, sheet title, footer column heads — body font at 550–600.

body.purpose: All Korean/Latin running text at a single 15px; hierarchy is tracking, weight, and ink.

label.purpose: Tracked micro captions, dims, prices, and instrument labels (.10–.3em).

motion.name: rail-draw
motion.purpose: The master rail draws itself once on load.

motion.name: sodium-landing
motion.purpose: The signature moment: the sodium doubled line lands with one spring overshoot.

motion.name: settle-rise
motion.purpose: Staggered entrance settle for hero blocks.

motion.name: sheet-slide
motion.purpose: Product sheet panel slides in over the scrim.

motion.name: tick-response
motion.purpose: Control response: tick scaleX(1.7), mat band step, tracking breathe.

motion.name: toast-emerge
motion.purpose: Readout toast rises from below and holds 2.4s.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion is disabled and end-states shown.

components.name: Tick Button — Line
components.description: Secondary control the instrument draws: a hairline tick that extends on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-tick-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .18em; padding: 12px 2px; transition: letter-spacing .25s ease; } .ds-tick-btn .ds-tick { width: 26px; height: 1px; background: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform .25s ease, background .25s ease; } .ds-tick-btn:hover .ds-tick, .ds-tick-btn:focus-visible .ds-tick { transform: scaleX(1.7); } .ds-tick-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--bone, #D8D3C7); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tick Button — Fill
components.description: Primary action: same grammar inverted — bone border floods to bone on hover, inverting text and tick.
components.css: .ds-tick-btn-fill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; background: none; border: 1px solid var(--bone, #D8D3C7); cursor: pointer; color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .18em; padding: 12px 22px; transition: background .25s ease, color .25s ease; } .ds-tick-btn-fill .ds-tick-line { order: 2; width: 26px; height: 1px; background: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform .25s ease, background .25s ease; } .ds-tick-btn-fill:hover, .ds-tick-btn-fill:focus-visible { background: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); color: var(--c0, #0E0D0B); } .ds-tick-btn-fill:hover .ds-tick-line, .ds-tick-btn-fill:focus-visible .ds-tick-line { background: var(--c0, #0E0D0B); transform: scaleX(1.7); } .ds-tick-btn-fill:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--bone, #D8D3C7); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Look Card
components.description: A registered specimen: graphite plate one band up, inner hairline, wavelength line, tabular price, line-form state.
components.css: .ds-look-card { display: block; text-align: left; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; } .ds-mat { position: relative; background: var(--c2, #161513); padding: 8px; transition: background .25s ease; } .ds-mat::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(216,211,199,.22)); pointer-events: none; transition: border-color .25s ease; } .ds-photo { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: #26241f; } .ds-look-card:hover .ds-mat { background: var(--c3, #1C1A17); } .ds-look-card:hover .ds-mat::after { border-color: var(--hair-strong, rgba(216,211,199,.45)); } .ds-look-card:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--bone, #D8D3C7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-data { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; column-gap: 12px; padding: 13px 2px 0; } .ds-waveline { height: 22px; width: 1px; background: var(--nm405, #7B6BC4); grid-row: span 2; } .ds-no { font-weight: 340; letter-spacing: .2em; color: var(--bone-2, #A39C8F); } .ds-price { text-align: right; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-name { grid-column: 2; font-weight: 550; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-state { grid-column: 3; justify-self: end; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; } .ds-state span { font-weight: 340; letter-spacing: .10em; color: var(--bone-2, #A39C8F); }

components.name: State Line Glyphs
components.description: Signature: commerce state as line form, never hue — solid, dashed, half-height, struck.
components.html: 판매 중   드롭 예정   품절 임박   품절
components.css: .ds-states { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--bone-2, #A39C8F); } .ds-stateline { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 1px; height: 14px; vertical-align: middle; background: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); } .ds-stateline.ds-pending { background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--bone, #D8D3C7) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); } .ds-stateline.ds-low { height: 7px; } .ds-stateline.ds-out { background: var(--bone-3, #8D8679); } .ds-stateline.ds-out::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -4px; top: 6px; width: 9px; height: 1px; background: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); transform: rotate(-32deg); }

components.name: Doubled Sodium Line
components.description: Signature: the 589nm doubled line — two 1px lines 3px apart; sodium is the only wavelength that may ink its own label.
components.css: .ds-duo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-spec-doubled { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 1px; height: 14px; background: var(--nm589, #E5B84B); } .ds-spec-doubled::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: var(--nm589, #E5B84B); } .ds-duo-lbl { font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Mast Nav Link

components.html: 컬렉션589
components.css: .ds-mast-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; background: var(--c0, #0E0D0B); padding: 20px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(216,211,199,.22)); } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 450; letter-spacing: .16em; color: var(--bone-2, #A39C8F); transition: color .2s ease; } .ds-nav-link i { width: 14px; height: 1px; background: var(--bone-3, #8D8679); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform .2s ease, background .2s ease; font-style: normal; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.ds-active { color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); } .ds-nav-link:hover i, .ds-nav-link.ds-active i { transform: scaleX(1.7); background: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--bone, #D8D3C7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-duo-tick { width: 5px; height: 12px; position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-duo-tick i { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: var(--nm589, #E5B84B); } .ds-duo-tick i:last-child { left: 4px; }

components.name: Legend Key

components.css: .ds-legend-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--bone-2, #A39C8F); } .ds-legend-key b { font-weight: 650; color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); letter-spacing: .04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-specl { display: inline-block; width: 1px; height: 14px; background: var(--nm436, #5B7BD6); }

components.name: Size Chip
components.description: Sheet size selector: hairline border, selected state strengthens border and ink — form, not fill.
components.css: .ds-sizes { display: flex; gap: 10px; } .ds-size { flex: 1; padding: 12px 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(216,211,199,.22)); font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: .2em; color: var(--bone-2, #A39C8F); transition: border-color .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-size:hover { border-color: var(--hair-strong, rgba(216,211,199,.45)); color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); } .ds-size.ds-selected, .ds-size[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); color: var(--bone, #D8D3C7); } .ds-size:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--bone, #D8D3C7); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: 방출선 레일 — the catalog is a spectrographic measuring instrument (카탈로그는 분광 계측기다)
narrative.overview:
The shop presents itself as a calibrated spectroscope. Every product registers as an emission line on one master rail spanning the visible band (380–700nm); category is wavelength, and the only chroma on the page is the seven physically meaningful spectral hairlines. Everything else is a warm charcoal continuum whose depth comes solely from band steps, written over with bone-toned legends. It rejects both the white-grid selective default and the gold-serif dark-luxury counter-default.

Typography is a single voice: one grotesque for all Korean/Latin running text at one size (15px), where hierarchy is produced by tracking (.02–.3em), weight (340–650), and ink (the bone ladder) — never by size or color. A condensed variable grotesque (Archivo, width axis 72–80%) is reserved for the house wordmark, section headlines, and instrument numerals. All figures are tabular. Photography is desaturated to graphite, matted on plates with a 1px bone inner hairline, under one fixed 5% film-grain overlay that is the plate's own texture. Motion has exactly one authored moment — the rail draws itself and the sodium doubled line lands with a single spring overshoot — after which everything settles and responds in quiet 0.25–0.45s eases.

Where the build diverged from the direction contract, the build won and is canonized here: the contract confined color strictly to wavelength hairlines, but the shipped page also inks sodium's own vertical rail label, the global caret, and the NOW label's top rule in --nm589 (the Sodium Ink exception below); and the wavelength legend carries an explicit doubled-line entry (589 이중선 — 에디터) alongside the six single-line categories.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal continuum ground (four bands, no gradients, no shadows) with bone legends and 1px hairlines
Chroma exists only as seven wavelength emission lines; sodium 589 is doubled and outranks its neighbours
State is line form, never hue: solid = live, dashed = drop pending, half-height = nearly sold out, struck = sold out
One text size (15px) for all UI copy; hierarchy by tracking, weight, and ink; tabular numerals everywhere
The fixed master rail is the page's spine and its only ornament; photography is graphite-matted with provenance recorded

rules.name: The Emission-Only Chroma Rule
rules.body: No color outside the seven wavelengths (plus the bone/charcoal neutrals) may appear anywhere. A wavelength is used only where it names a physical nm position: a category line, a drop tick, the doubled sodium. The Sodium Ink exception: --nm589 may additionally serve as ink for sodium's own label, the caret, and the NOW rule — nothing else, no other wavelength gets ink duty.

rules.name: The Line-Form State Rule
rules.body: Commerce state is never communicated by hue. Solid 1px line = 판매 중 (live); dashed line (repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, bone 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px) on a 1px-wide element) = 드롭 예정 (pending); half-height line (7px of 14px) = 품절 임박 (nearly gone); struck line (1px diagonal through it) = 품절 (sold out).

rules.name: The Band-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is a continuum band step (c0 → c1 → c2 → c3) or the scrim — never a gradient, never a shadow.

rules.name: The One-Size Rule
rules.body: 15px is the only size for UI and reading text. Hierarchy is tracking (.02–.3em), weight (340–650), and ink (bone ladder). The only other sizes are Archivo display/numerals and the 10–12px engraved instrument labels. Never add a mid-range text size to create emphasis.

rules.name: The Tabular-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every figure is tabular (tabular-nums is set on body and inherited); emphasis among figures comes from weight (650) and ink, never from a different family or size.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never introduce box-shadow, text-shadow, or drop-shadow. If an element needs to sit higher, step its continuum band or open the scrim. The grain overlay is the only permitted global texture and stays at 5% opacity, non-interactive, topmost but under the toast's z-order intent (grain 60, sheet 80, toast 90).

dos: Do express every state as line form (solid/dashed/half/struck) with the exact grammar in the Line-Form State Rule — including the repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--bone) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px) dash, which is the world's own drafting mark for "registered, not yet live".
Do keep one 15px text size; build hierarchy with tracking (.02–.3em), weight (340–650), and the bone ink ladder, and set all figures tabular.

Do mount photography as graphite plates: one-band-up mat, 8–10px padding, 1px inner bone hairline, filter: contrast(1.02) on the image; record provenance for every shipped raster (see assets/PROVENANCE.json).
Do keep the 5% fixed grain overlay as the single global texture, and let hover raise surfaces exactly one continuum band with a hairline strengthen (.22 → .45).
Do place chroma only at physically meaningful nm positions, and reserve doubled-line sodium outranking for exactly one emphasis per view.
donts: Don't use gradients, box/text/fit shadows, or border-radius other than 0 — depth is band steps and the scrim; corners are square.
Don't encode meaning in hue (no red errors, no green confirmations); state, selection, and emphasis are line form, ink, and weight.
Don't introduce any text color outside the bone ladder and the seven wavelength values (with the sodium-ink exception), or any size between the 15px body rank and the Archivo display scale.

Don't animate beyond the grammar: one authored rail moment on load, settle rises (.8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) with .25–.7s stagger), .25s control response, .45s sheet slide — and always honor prefers-reduced-motion by disabling all of it.
Don't let the grid's density changes resize type; breakpoints shorten the band, collapse columns, and hide graduation labels — never the type.
